IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: House Appropriations Subcommittee on General Government & Audit Review (originally sponsored by Representative O'Brien)

Bill.BriefDescription: Providing funding for a patrol vessel for public protection and emergencies.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing funding for a patrol vessel for publicprotection and emergencies; adding a new section to chapter 36.28A RCW;and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.28A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: When funded, the Washington association of sheriffs and policechiefs shall convene and facilitate a work group of sheriffs andemergency managers from the counties of Island, Snohomish, Skagit,Whatcom, San Juan, Clallam, and Jefferson, and other appropriateindividuals, to study and make recommendations regarding theenhancement of current recreational boating enforcement programs toinclude coastal defense duties. The Washington association of sheriffsand police chiefs shall report the findings and recommendations of thework group to the legislature by December 31, 2008.

If specific funding for the purposes of thisact, referencing this act by bill or chapter number, is not provided by p. 1 2SHB 2505June 30, 2009, in the omnibus appropriations act, this act is null andvoid.
